title: DCC: Data-Centric Compilation of Machine Learning Kernels for Processing-In-Memory Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2511.15503v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: High-performance Host processors can integrate Processing-In-Memory (PIM) devices, which can accelerate memory-intensive kernels of Machine Learning (ML) models, including Large Language Models (LLMs), by leveraging the large memory bandwidth available at PIM cores. However, Host processor needs consecutive elements distributed across DRAM banks, while PIM cores need consecutive elements within their local banks. This necessitates data rearrangements in ML kernel execution that pose significant performance and programmability challenges, further exacerbated by the need to support diverse PIM devices. Current compilation approaches lack systematic optimization for diverse ML kernels and multiple PIM devices, and may largely ignore data rearrangement costs during the compute code optimization step. We show that data rearrangements and compute code optimization are interdependent, and need to be jointly optimized during the tuning

translated_title: DCC：面向存内计算架构的以数据为中心的机器学习内核编译
translated_abstract: 高性能主机处理器可以集成存内计算（PIM）设备，这些设备能够通过利用PIM核心可用的大内存带宽，加速机器学习模型（包括大语言模型）中内存密集型的内核。然而，主机处理器需要连续元素分布在DRAM存储体之间，而PIM核心则需要连续元素位于其本地存储体内部。这使得机器学习内核执行过程中必须进行数据重排，从而带来显著的性能和可编程性挑战，而支持多样化PIM设备的需求进一步加剧了这些挑战。当前的编译方法缺乏对多样化机器学习内核和多种PIM设备的系统性优化，并且在计算代码优化步骤中可能在很大程度上忽略数据重排的开销。我们证明了数据重排与计算代码优化是相互依赖的，需要在调优过程中进行联合优化。
tldr: 提出DCC编译框架，以数据为中心将数据重排与计算代码优化进行联合调优，从而系统性地为多样化机器学习内核生成适配多种存内计算架构的高效代码。
en_tdlr: DCC is a data-centric compilation framework that jointly optimizes data rearrangements and compute code generation, enabling efficient execution of diverse ML kernels across multiple Processing-In-Memory architectures.
